description:
Build deterministic one-day event options with ICS and calendar links.

    Separates complete options, partial_options, unverified_budget and date-only
    flexible_entries (never placed in timed plans/calendars). Checks time gaps and
    published age compatibility, not travel feasibility or live ticket availability.
    Read istanbul://guides/events for full planning/fulfillment rules.

budget_includes_fees.description: Keep unknown fee totals unverified against max_price_try.
budget_includes_fees.title: Budget Includes Fees

child_age.description: Child age (0-17); restricts to family events with matching published age range.
child_age.title: Child Age

date.description: Plan date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow (default today in Europe/Istanbul).
date.title: Date

district.description: District for candidate discovery when event_ids is omitted.
district.title: District

event_ids.description: 1-20 event_id or performance_id values from search/detail.
event_ids.title: Event Ids

exclude_child_only.description: Exclude sessions whose published upper age limit is below 18.
exclude_child_only.title: Exclude Child Only

limit.description: Max plan options to return (1-5, default 3).
limit.title: Limit

max_events.description: Maximum stops per plan option (1-3, default 3).
max_events.title: Max Events

max_price_try.description: Total observed party budget across all stops in TRY.
max_price_try.title: Max Price Try

min_events.description: Required minimum stops per complete plan (1..max_events).
min_events.title: Min Events

min_gap_minutes.description: Minimum gap between sessions in minutes (0-240, default 30).
min_gap_minutes.title: Min Gap Minutes

party.description: Mixed group counts by profile, e.g. {'adult': 2, 'child': 1}.
party.title: Party

party_size.description: Group size (1-50) priced across every stop.
party_size.title: Party Size

require_known_end.description: Exclude sessions without a known end time.
require_known_end.title: Require Known End

required_categories.description: Categories that must each appear at least once in complete plans.
required_categories.title: Required Categories

start_time.description: Earliest plan window clock (HH:MM, default '18:00', or '09:00' when only a daytime end_time <= 18:00 is given).
start_time.title: Start Time

ticket_profile.description: Attendee ticket profile: general, adult, student, child, senior, or any.
ticket_profile.title: Ticket Profile

name: istanbul_events_plan

license.default: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License

url.description: Human-readable source page for citations; null when the source is only an API endpoint or data file.

title: İstanbul günlük etkinlik planı
